What We Eat in America
Community nutrition is a constantly evolving and growing area 
of practice with the broad focus of serving the general popula-
tion. Although this practice area encompasses the goals of public 
health, in the United States the current model has been shaped 
and expanded by prevention and wellness initiatives that evolved 
in the 1960s. Because the thrust of community nutrition is to be 
proactive and responsive to the needs of the community, current 
emphasis areas include access to a nutritionally adequate and safe 
food supply along with disaster and pandemic control, food and 
water safety, and controlling environmental risk
